name: Tiel-Coder-35B-A3B (community requant of Ornith-1.5)

lineage.how_derived: re-quantized with Unsloth-style dynamic recipes on an own importance matrix (49M characters, about three quarters code), Sharp chat template inside the GGUF; no MTP head in these tiers

purpose: Publisher states: agentic coding and long useful multi-turn conversations; weak at trivia and exam-style knowledge.

license.name: MIT (inherited from Ornith-1.5)
license.notes: Card says "MIT, inheriting Ornith-1.5's license"; the repository has no LICENSE file and the parent has none either, so no text was read.

architecture.kind: hybrid Gated DeltaNet + gated attention MoE
architecture.why_this_design: Inherited from Ornith-1.5-35B-A3B (MIT per card); the card describes quantization tiers, not architecture reasons.

variants.notes: recommended starting point; tiers from 12.3 GB (Q2_K_XL) to 38.5 GB (Q8_K_XL)

pc-12gb.notes: estimate from the file size (22.4 GB) against the budget of docs/hardware: 9.6 GB VRAM plus 50 GB RAM = 60 GB; about 43% of the file can sit in VRAM, the rest streams from RAM (decode speed depends on that); UD-IQ3_XXS (13.2 GB) fits 16 GB VRAM almost wholly

pc-16gb.notes: estimate from the file size (22.4 GB) against the budget of docs/hardware: 13.6 GB VRAM plus 50 GB RAM = 64 GB; about 61% of the file can sit in VRAM, the rest streams from RAM (decode speed depends on that); UD-IQ3_XXS (13.2 GB) fits 16 GB VRAM almost wholly

pc-24gb.notes: estimate from the file size (22.4 GB) against the budget of docs/hardware: 21.6 GB VRAM plus 82 GB RAM = 104 GB; about 96% of the file can sit in VRAM, the rest streams from RAM (decode speed depends on that); UD-IQ3_XXS (13.2 GB) fits 16 GB VRAM almost wholly

pc-32gb.notes: estimate from the file size (22.4 GB) against the budget of docs/hardware: 29.6 GB VRAM plus 114 GB RAM = 144 GB; about 100% of the file can sit in VRAM, the rest streams from RAM (decode speed depends on that); UD-IQ3_XXS (13.2 GB) fits 16 GB VRAM almost wholly

mac-16-24gb.notes: estimate from the file size (22.4 GB) against the GPU share of docs/hardware (about 12 GB); UD-IQ3_XXS (13.2 GB) fits 16 GB VRAM almost wholly

mac-32gb.notes: estimate from the file size (22.4 GB) against the GPU share of docs/hardware (about 22 GB); UD-IQ3_XXS (13.2 GB) fits 16 GB VRAM almost wholly

mac-64gb+.notes: estimate from the file size (22.4 GB) against the GPU share of docs/hardware (about 52 GB); UD-IQ3_XXS (13.2 GB) fits 16 GB VRAM almost wholly

engine_support.notes: Tona runs Ornith's own Q4_K_M; whether the dynamic quant types load in Tona's qwen35moe path is unchecked

benchmarks.name: SWE-bench-Live (25 problems)
benchmarks.variant: Tiel, one run per problem (Ornith-1.5: 8, Qwen3.8-27B: 16)

strengths: Code-weighted imatrix: slightly better multi-turn agent score than stock Ornith on the publisher's run
weaknesses: Self-reported, small samples (25 problems, one run)
Loses 4.3 points MMLU-Pro against Ornith; asks fewer clarifying questions
soft.behavior: Asks 5.1 points fewer clarifying questions than Ornith-1.5 (publisher).
soft.maturity: Anonymous community publisher; 2.8M downloads of the MTP variant of the same line show wide use.

tona_fit.reason: An IQ3 tier at 13.2 GB fits 16 GB VRAM wholly, which could remove expert streaming; quality against Ornith Q4_K_M must be measured by us first.
blockers: needs a loading check for the dynamic quant types

sources.note: page text read through a summarizer (WebFetch)

open_questions: Independent quality of the IQ3 tier
